Metadata.title: AI Knowledge Base
Metadata.description: Ask your documents. Get answers with sources.

Nav.sidebarDescription: Search indexed PDFs, get cited answers, and manage collections from one place.

AppShell.tagline: Secure knowledge workspace · session lasts up to 8 hours

Login.brandTagline: Ask your documents. Get answers with sources.
Login.body: AI Knowledge Base is an enterprise RAG assistant: upload PDFs and DOCX, index them safely, then chat with grounded answers that show document name and page citations.
Login.bullet1: Dashboard chat with conversation history and collections
Login.bullet2: Document workspace for summarize, extract, and scoped ask
Login.bullet3: Admin upload, reindex, users, and usage analytics
Login.signInSubheading: Access your knowledge workspace — chat, documents, and admin tools.

DocumentWorkspace.title: Document Workspace
DocumentWorkspace.description: Upload files, then summarize, extract metadata, or ask questions scoped to a single document — answers still include citations when sources exist.
DocumentWorkspace.noDocumentsBody: Upload a PDF or DOCX above. After indexing finishes (status: ready), you can summarize, extract metadata, and chat about that file here.
DocumentWorkspace.readyNotice: Wait until status is ready before summarize / extract / chat.
DocumentWorkspace.summaryPlaceholder: Click Summarize to generate bullet points.
DocumentWorkspace.metadataPlaceholder: Click Extract Metadata for structured fields.
DocumentWorkspace.selectDocumentPrompt: Select a document to get started.

Chat.noSavedChats: No saved chats yet. Ask a question to start one.
Chat.deleteConversationDescription: This chat and its messages will be removed permanently.
Chat.knowledgeChatSubtitle: Ask questions — answers cite your uploaded documents.
Chat.emptyStateBodyEmpty: No indexed documents yet. Upload PDFs or DOCX from Documents — once status is ready, chat can answer from your knowledge base.
Chat.emptyStateBodyReady: Ask about policies, SOPs, or product docs — answers include citations when sources exist.

AdminSettings.title: Admin Settings
AdminSettings.description: Keep the knowledge base healthy: upload and reindex PDFs/DOCX, organize collections, provision assistants and admins, and review usage analytics.

Dashboard.body: Upload company PDFs and DOCX files, then ask natural questions. The assistant answers only from your indexed documents and shows
Dashboard.bodySuffix: so teammates can verify every claim.
Dashboard.howItHelpsBody: Three things this product is built for — discover, verify, and manage company knowledge.
Dashboard.feature1Body: Every substantive reply points back to a document and page — so you can trust what you read.
Dashboard.feature2Body: Ask about policies, SOPs, and product PDFs. The knowledge base retrieves the closest chunks first.
Dashboard.feature3Body: Role-based access for assistants and admins. Short sessions keep company knowledge protected.
Dashboard.askBody: Use the chat below for grounded Q&A. Pick a collection if you want to limit the search scope.
